source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: AttachmentListController advertises generic delete and shift-delete as enabled and handles them through HandleSelectedAttachments. HandleMultipleAttachments then returns when message policy forbids delete/detach. This keeps command handling separate from permission to modify content. Preserve that distinction when changing attachment keyboard behavior; a disabled command can have a different dispatch contract. The owned landing rejects a whole mixed selection through every(), whereas selected fixed code filters unusable entries. This is comm source evidence, not an executed controller-fallthrough test.
title: Attachment Delete remains handled while the shared action guard rejects modification
